# The Epicenter    of Disruptive Breakthroughs

iTNT is harnessing the synergistic power of startups, industry, academia,
government, and global collaborators to enrich DeepTech and Emerging Technologies to
Innovate In Tamil Nadu & Build The Future, by nurturing a conducive R&D&I ecosystem.


[LEARN MORE](https://itnthub.tn.gov.in/About_Us.html) [DOWNLOAD BROCHURE](https://itnthub.tn.gov.in/assets/The-iTNT-Story-Brochure.pdf)

![](https://itnthub.tn.gov.in/assets/hero/cards.png)

## Catalyzing Global Innovations

iTNT is building India’s largest DeepTech and Emerging Tech Innovation Network by catalyzing
and leveraging the strengths of diverse stakeholders. We pave the way for trailblazers
and empower them to push the frontiers of technology by bringing together diverse
talents and providing access to world class infrastructure. Our collaborative ecosystem
sparks breakthrough innovations that uplift communities worldwide.


[Learn More](https://itnthub.tn.gov.in/About_Us.html)
